ExplosionDamage.en: Grenade damage at the blast point, falling off to zero at the damage radius.

ExplosionRadius.en: How far creature and player damage reaches. Does not change the visual size or structure damage.

GrenadeEffectRadius.en: Radius of the visual explosion and of structure damage.

BuildableDamage.en: Flat damage to blocks and buildables within the effect radius.

GrenadeNoiseRadius.en: How far zombies can hear a grenade.

GrenadeFlashScale.en: Multiplier on the bright flash and fireball. 1 is the original look.

GrenadeParticulateScale.en: Multiplier on debris and smoke. 1 is the original look.

EnableNailbomb.en: Register the nail bomb item. Takes effect after restarting the game.

NailbombDamage.en: Total shrapnel damage at the blast point, split across how much of a target is exposed.

NailbombRadius.en: How far fragments travel. Cover still protects: fragments only hurt what they can reach in a straight line.

NailbombFragmentDamage.en: Raise to make close range brutal without widening the range.

NailbombBlockDamage.en: Flat damage to blocks. Token by design: nails do not bring down walls.

NailbombCausesBleed.en: Apply the bleeding debuff when shrapnel hits the player. The game's bleed system is player-only.

NailbombNoiseRadius.en: How far zombies can hear a nail bomb.

NailbombVisualRadiusMultiplier.en: Fraction of the fragment range used for the visual effect only.

NailbombFlashScale.en: Multiplier on the bright flash and fireball. 1 is the original look.

NailbombParticulateScale.en: Multiplier on debris and smoke. 1 is the original look.

MinThrowSpeed.en: Throw speed for a tap with no hold.

MaxThrowSpeed.en: Throw speed after holding for the full charge time.

MaxChargeSeconds.en: How long the button must be held to reach full throw speed.

QuickThrowKey.en: Hold to charge and throw the first explosive on your hotbar.

CancelChargeKey.en: Press while charging to abort. A right-click tap always cancels too.

EnableThrowAnimation.en: Play a throw animation on release in third person.

ThrowAnimationSpeed.en: Playback speed of the throw clip. The release point scales with it automatically.

ThrowAnimationInFirstPerson.en: Off by default: the clip is a third-person throw and looks like flailing arms from inside the head.

EnableSwingSound.en: Play the game's melee swing whoosh during the throw.

SwingSoundVolume.en: Multiplier on the swing sound. 1 is as loud as the axe.

AllowSelfDamage.en: Your own explosives can hurt you.

SelfDamageMultiplier.en: Applied only to damage you take from your own explosives. 1 is full risk.

ExplosionsAttractZombies.en: Zombies path to the blast, not to you, so a thrown explosive works as a distraction.

ExplosionVolume.en: Volume of the detonation. Values above 1 amplify.

EchoDelay.en: Seconds before the returning crack off distant geometry. 0 with echo volume 0 disables it.

EchoVolume.en: Level of the echo relative to the blast. 0 disables it.

EnableLootSpawning.en: Let explosives appear in world containers, inheriting the rarity of the loot tags below. Takes effect after restarting the game.

LootTags.en: Comma-separated loot tags to add explosives to. Open a container once with diagnostics on to see the list in the log. Takes effect after restarting the game.

EnableDiagnostics.en: Log extra detail about items, crafting tabs and loot tags.
